svg.title: eclipsed. — private rooms
svg.desc: eclipsed. — a private chat where rooms connect directly between browsers. Messages travel peer to peer, history stays on each device, and nothing is stored on a server.

xhtml:div.xhtml:span: Set your name to start talking

xhtml:div.xhtml:p: Once your friend opens the invite, they’ll get a long reply to send back. Paste it below to open the room. The link then stays alive via mesh keepalive.

xhtml:div.xhtml:div: Send this reply back to the person who invited you — the room opens the moment they paste it.

xhtml:div.xhtml:p: Private rooms, direct between your devices

xhtml:div.xhtml:span: No servers · No storage · No accounts · It all stays between you · No servers · No storage · No accounts · It all stays between you · No servers · No storage · No accounts · It all stays between you
No servers · No storage · No accounts · It all stays between you · No servers · No storage · No accounts · It all stays between you · No servers · No storage · No accounts · It all stays between you

xhtml:section.xhtml:p: Create a room with a short code — mesh members join with the code, newcomers with the long invite. No servers.

xhtml:div.xhtml:p: Choose a code (1–32 letters, numbers, - or _). Mesh members join with the code — newcomers join with the long invite below.

xhtml:label.xhtml:span: Lock this room with a password

xhtml:input.placeholder: Only people with the password can join

xhtml:span.title: Tap to copy this room code

xhtml:div.xhtml:p: Anyone who pastes this link lands directly in this room. Mesh members can also join with #code — tap the chip to copy it:
Type a mesh room code — it connects automatically. First time here? Paste the long invite instead.

xhtml:details.xhtml:summary: Have an invite link instead? Paste it here

xhtml:textarea.placeholder: Paste the invite link or code they sent you…

xhtml:input.placeholder: Password, if the room is locked

xhtml:div.xhtml:span: This room is peer-to-peer — everything here stays on your devices.

xhtml:aside.xhtml:div: Room admin is granted by the private profile code. No voting or first-user ownership is used.

xhtml:div.xhtml:p: So incoming messages can reach you. Nothing is stored online.
This room is locked. Enter its password to continue.
One name and one auto-assigned hex — they stick to this device. No account, no password to remember.
Optional. Your picture is sent to your rooms so the people there see it too. It stays on your devices.
